p3_b0.ocr: The telecommunications sector has seen significant fluctuations in both spectrum acquisition costs and roaming revenue trends, particularly in North America.

p3_b2.ocr: An analysis of these trends reveals that in 2022, the average revenue generated from roaming services has reached approximately $600M, reflecting a robust increase compared to previous years. Notably, the number of units sold in the same year was 1.5M, demonstrating a consistent demand for mobile connectivity despite evolving market dynamics.

p3_b3.ocr: Additionally, the average revenue per unit sold showcased a remarkable growth, with average revenue figures rising to $200M, indicative of enhanced pricing strategies and improved service offerings. The upward trajectory is further highlighted by the increase in spectrum acquisition costs, which escalated from $500M to $600M, aligning with the industry's push for advanced technology and infrastructure development.

p3_b5.ocr: Furthermore, the total number of frequency bands utilized has risen from 200 to 220, supporting the surge in demand for high- quality telecom services.

p3_b6.ocr: This trend underscores the strategic importance of effective spectrum management and revenue optimization in navigating the competitive landscape of the telecommunications market, while also addressing consumer needs for greater data capacity and connectivity options. As the industry evolves, these metrics will be critical in evaluating future growth and investment opportunities.
